name: ssh_script
description: Cross-platform SSH key automation script for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket
summary: A POSIX-compliant shell script for automated SSH key generation and configuration across multiple Git platforms. Supports macOS, Linux, Windows (WSL), and Git Bash with smart clipboard integration. Features automatic SSH agent setup, config file management, and one-command authentication for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.
